 Advertisement Updated: 12:31 PM EDT Oct 20, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Lauren Blois Hannaford website, app restored after outage
 Updated: 12:31 PM EDT Oct 20, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ By Lauren Blois MANCHESTER, N.H. — Hannaford's website and app are back online nearly one week after they were shut down due to a "cybersecurity issue."
 Officials say other grocery chains owned by the same Dutch parent company across the country were affected by the outage.
 Advertisement Physical stores and pharmacies were operating like normal, but delivery and pickup services were out of service for a week .
 In a statement released Tuesday morning, Hannaford is giving rewards members $10 off a $100 purchase through Oct. 28.
